name: Lensmor
summary: Trade-show prospecting for B2B teams: search events for free, then spend credits to unlock exhibitor, attendee and visitor lists and to reveal verified emails and phone numbers, with an AI agent that shortlists shows that fit your ideal customer profile.
best_for: B2B sales and marketing teams that exhibit at or prospect around trade shows and want exhibitor and attendee lists per event, with verified contacts revealed only for the accounts that fit
skip_if: you need a general B2B contact database rather than event data, or a budget of $499 a month is out of reach for your team
honest_knock: The entry price is high: $499 a month for Basic, and the free start is a one-time grant of 2,000 credits, not a free plan. Credits go fast: one full event unlock is 5,000 credits, and every phone number another 150. Visitor data depends on the event and needs a paid plan. Subscription fees are non-refundable except where the law requires otherwise, and the subscription renews unless you cancel before the end of the billing cycle.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · flat price for a workspace of up to 5 seats with 35,000 credits a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-26 on lensmor.com/pricing and Lensmor's billing policy in its help centre; dollar amounts, the pages do not name the currency) Lensmor sells credits. Every new account starts with 2,000 free credits, without a credit card. Basic is $499 a month or $4,990 a year, for 35,000 credits a month and a shared workspace of up to 5 seats; the credits reset every month, also on annual billing. Growth is $14,900 a year for 1,500,000 credits per annual term and up to 10 seats, with priority email and WhatsApp support. Enterprise is a custom annual agreement with API access and integrations. Active paid subscribers can buy add-on credits: 10,000 for $249, 25,000 for $549 or 60,000 for $1,199, valid for 12 months. What credits buy: unlocking an event's exhibitors and public-signal attendees costs 2,000 credits, full access including visitors 5,000 (or 3,000 to add visitors later), a returned email 15, a returned phone number 150, and a search by exhibitor 50 when it finds matches. Unused subscription credits do not roll over, and subscription fees are non-refundable.
